general_ui_ux_design_guidelines: Adopt 'Mode B: High Density Grid' strategy. Utilize tight spacing (gap-4 or gap-6) and avoid empty dead space to allow dense data rendering.
Prioritize 'Cardless' UI or flat surfaces with sharp edges (max 8px border-radius). Avoid soft, muddy shadows.
Use optical alignment and structured hierarchies. Use 1px solid borders (border-slate-200) to separate sections rather than relying on shadow elevations.
Never use completely transparent backgrounds for headers, overlays, or dropdowns. Ensure solid backgrounds (bg-white) with crisp borders.
Do not center-align layouts or dense content. Left-align paragraphs, inputs, labels, and tabular data to ensure legal data legibility.
Ensure 'prefers-reduced-motion' is respected. Avoid universal transition (transition: all). Target specific properties (e.g., transition-colors).

rules: Use #00a0a0 strictly for primary actions, active navigation states, and key chart metrics.
Use #f0b43c for high-priority alerts, reminders, and pending approval statuses.
Never use pure black or pure white for text; use text-slate-900 or text-slate-600 to reduce eye strain.
No generic fonts (Inter, Roboto, Open Sans). Add Outfit and IBM Plex Sans from Google Fonts.
Headings (Outfit): Use tracking-tight, font-semibold to font-bold. Max size for dashboard pages is text-3xl.
Body (IBM Plex Sans): Use leading-relaxed for long text, tracking-normal. Highly readable for legal data.
Overlines/Labels: Uppercase, tracking-widest, text-xs, font-medium, text-slate-500.

layouts_and_grids.dashboard_grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 or gap-6.
layouts_and_grids.spacing: Generous internal padding for distinct forms (p-6 or p-8). Tighter gaps for data-heavy views.

component_strategy.forms: Multi-section forms should use Shadcn Tabs or a custom vertical Stepper. Keep inputs dense but clear. Use Shadcn Input, Select, and Form.
component_strategy.tables: Use crisp tables with border-b border-border. Add hover:bg-slate-50 on rows. Implement sticky headers if the list is long. Integrate search & filter inline.
component_strategy.approval_center: Use dual-action UI: Tosca for 'Approve/Review', subtle Red outline/ghost button for 'Reject'. Include a prominent status badge.
component_strategy.timeline_perkara: Build a vertical timeline visualizer using absolute positioning or left-bordered lists (border-l-2 border-slate-200) with solid indicator dots.
component_strategy.charts: Use Recharts. Ensure chart colors map to the brand: Primary (#00a0a0), Accent (#f0b43c), and neutral slate for secondary data.
component_strategy.alerts_panel: Use a subtle yellow/gold background (bg-yellow-50) with #f0b43c borders to highlight impending court dates (jadwal sidang).

media_and_icons.icon_library: lucide-react (Standard, clean, scales well for dashboards)

images.description: Aerial view of Jakarta's modern urban skyline. Use with a heavy overlay (e.g., bg-slate-900/80 or bg-[#00a0a0]/90) so the login card contrasts perfectly.

media_and_icons.rules: No placeholder images allowed. Use the provided Jakarta skyline for the login screen.

accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: All interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs, tabs, export buttons, case row clicks) MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button').
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure text over brand colors meets a minimum 4.5:1 ratio. White text on #00a0a0 is compliant. Dark text on #f0b43c.

instructions_to_main_agent: Initialize Tailwind CSS and configure the theme extensions for primary (#00a0a0) and accent (#f0b43c).
Inject the Google Fonts 'Outfit' and 'IBM Plex Sans' into the main index.html or App.css.
Build the components using .js and .jsx extensions (NO TypeScript / .tsx files).
Create the Login page with a split layout or centered card over the provided Jakarta skyline image.
Build a robust Sidebar navigation layout covering the requested modules (Dashboard, Data Perkara, Approval Center, Timeline, Dokumen, Laporan, Master Data).
Use Recharts for the Dashboard KPI charts (Bar, Pie).
Construct the multi-section 'Data Perkara' form using state-driven tabs/sections.
Implement the 'Approval Center' with clear Maker-Checker UI semantics.
Ensure the UI uses 'Cardless' or flat design with 1px borders, avoiding generic soft shadows.
Implement toasts using 'sonner' for success/error feedback (e.g., after approval/rejection or document upload).
